name: host_fs
description: Gwennol filesystem step types. Native code; every step asks the operator before acting. Nothing here is freelyUsable: a plugin must hold the matching step_type:host_fs.* grant. Answers the model can act on — no such file, that is a directory, permission denied — are results with an `outcome` naming them, not step errors; step errors are reserved for the operator's denial, the kernel's refusal, cancellation, and I/O failures nobody can act on.

path.description: File path; relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

max_bytes.description: Cap on returned bytes (default 1 MiB, clamped to 64 MiB). Bounds what is read, not just what is returned; the result reports truncation.

content.description: File contents, lossily decoded as UTF-8.

size.description: Full size of the file in bytes.

oneOf.description: The filesystem's answer, for the model to act on. Approved like a read: the operator saw the probed path first.

message.description: One line naming the outcome and the path, fit to hand the model verbatim.

oneOf.description: The destination cannot take the file: a missing parent without create_dirs, a directory in the way, a component that is not a directory, permission denied, or a symlink (never written through; refused rather than replaced). Nothing was written. Approved first like every probe — a symlink under the link's own name with its parent canonical, the rest under the path canonical to its deepest canonicalisable ancestor.

max_entries.description: Cap on returned entries (default 1000, clamped to 100000). The result reports truncation; a truncated listing is the first entries the directory yielded (sorted), not the lexicographically first.

oneOf.description: There is no directory to list: the path is missing, or names something that is not a directory, or may not be read.
